# truenas_zvol (Resource)

Manages a ZFS volume (zvol/block device) on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_zvol" "iso" {
  name    = "tank/iso"
  volsize = 10737418240 # 10 GiB
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full zvol path, e.g. tank/myvol.
- `volsize` (Number) Volume size in bytes.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Human-readable description.
- `compression` (String) Compression algorithm. Case-insensitive: lz4, zstd, off, etc.
- `dedup` (String) Deduplication: off, on, or verify.
- `sparse` (Boolean) Sparse provisioning (write-only; not returned by API).
- `sync` (String) Sync setting: standard, always, or disabled.
- `volblocksize` (Number) Block size in bytes (512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072). Set at create time only.

### Read-Only

- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the zvol is encrypted.
- `id` (String) Zvol name (used as Terraform ID).
- `pool` (String) Name of the pool containing this zvol.
